scope: Generic three-wall, gravity-seated roof and one-panel bridge fixtures, independent of source replicas. The seated roof has actual bearing area on its narrower U support. The bridge joins two individually built supports and preserves a separate table panel. Three perturbation seeds, two-finger edge proxy and explicit one-panel supports. No physical human or magnetic-force certification.
